title: A Hub of Short Rows Inflates Intrinsic Dimension Estimation of Token Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2608.29702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A token-embedding table holds a hub of short rows near its origin, and we show that this cluster biases what nearest-neighbor intrinsic-dimension (ID) estimators report. Because of the concentration of measure, a token is closer to the central cluster than to any other token, so its first two neighbors are both hub rows at nearly the same distance. As a result, the ID estimators such as TwoNN return a dimension far above the real ID. Measured one token at a time, dimension is a heavy-tailed distribution. Measured on the full vocabulary, it grows with the model's parameter count. However, when we remove the hub, the heavy tail disappears and the measured dimension collapses to a narrow range for eleven models, from GPT-2 to models such as K3 and GLM-4.7. translated_title: 短行枢纽夸大了词元嵌入的内在维度估计
translated_abstract: 词元嵌入表在原点附近存在一个由短行组成的枢纽，我们证明这一聚集会使最近邻内在维度（ID）估计器的结果产生偏差。由于测度集中现象，一个词元到该中心枢纽的距离比到任何其他词元都更近，因此其前两个近邻都是距离几乎相同的枢纽行。结果是，TwoNN 等内在维度估计器会返回远高于真实内在维度的数值。逐个词元测量时，维度呈重尾分布；在整个词表上测量时，维度随模型参数量的增长而增大。然而，当我们移除该枢纽后，重尾消失，从 GPT-2 到 K3、GLM-4.7 等十一个模型的测量维度都坍缩到一个狭窄区间。该枢纽如同一个开关：仅需几百行就足以完全夸大估计值。我们复现了一项实验，该实验指出 Pythia 的词元嵌入表的内在维度……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 词元嵌入表原点附近的短行枢纽会因测度集中效应使最近邻内在维度估计器（如TwoNN）的估计值被大幅夸大，而移除该枢纽后，从GPT-2到GLM-4.7等十一个模型的维度估计均坍缩至狭窄区间。
en_tdlr: A hub of short rows near the origin of token-embedding tables inflates nearest-neighbor intrinsic-dimension estimates (e.g., TwoNN) via concentration of measure, and removing this hub collapses the heavy-tailed, inflated dimension estimates to a narrow range across eleven models from GPT-2 to GLM-4.7.
